purpose: Select the host toolchain without changing the Darwin arm64/macOS 14 contract. No tolerance, fixture, expected value, mutant or oracle comparison changed.
darwin_dry_run: make HOST_OS=Darwin -n prints xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=14.0
linux_compile: clang++ with the same warning and FP flags, plus -funsigned-char so plain char matches the Apple ARM64 ABI
archive: tools/build/static_archive.sh uses xcrun libtool -static on Darwin and flattens nested archives into object members on Linux
judge_not_refreshed: Makefile is protected. The full gate required before a manifest refresh did not run. Inherited violations remain: tests/unit/native_gamma_fan.mm differs from the manifest after 9e279b4, and 53 oracle case bins are absent from this clone.
